Question 18
?

The graph shows a portion of the curve y=sin⁡x and the line y=12. Which of the following generates the x-values of all of their points of intersection? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=2π3+2nπ,x=5π6+2nπ
b
x=7π6+2nπ,x=4π3+2nπ
c
x=π6+2nπ,x=11π6+2nπ
d
x=π6+2nπ,x=5π6+2nπ
e
x=11π6+2nπ,x=2π3+2nπ
Submit
